If fruit does not exist, where can a combination of conditions exist?"},"philosophy":{"insight":"The FINAL CONCLUSION of Ch.20: (1) No inherent effect is produced by the combination (sāmagrī) of causes — shown in vv.1-23. (2) No inherent effect is produced WITHOUT a combination — that would be causeless arising. (3) If no inherent effect exists, the inherent \"combination of conditions\" also can't exist — because \"conditions\" is a relational term defined by producing effects. NO INHERENT CAUSATION EXISTS. But CONVENTIONAL causation works perfectly.","madhyamaka":"Tasmāt (therefore): na sāmagrī-kṛta phala (no fruit made by combination), na asāmagrī-kṛta phala (no fruit made by non-combination). Phala na asti cet (if fruit doesn't exist), sāmagrī kutra asti (where does the combination exist?). The final verse sweeps all: no inherent production from any source → no inherent effect → no inherent cause-combination.","quantum":"Quantum vacuum as conventional ground: the vacuum conventionally \"produces\" particles through fluctuations. But this production is not inherent — it's a dynamic, conventional process. Like v.24: conventional production from conventional conditions. No inherent production from any source.","bridge":"Both quantum vacuum production and v.24 affirm conventional production while denying inherent production. QM: vacuum conventionally produces particles (no inherent mechanism). V.24: no inherent fruit from combination or non-combination. Both: conventional production through empty processes.","accessible":"The cake isn't inherently produced by the ingredients (combination) or without ingredients (non-combination). And if there's no inherent cake, there are no inherent \"ingredients\" (which are defined by their role in making cake). Everything is conventional — and it WORKS.","twoTruths":"Conventionally: causes produce effects; combinations of conditions give rise to results. This is CONVENTIONAL REALITY — fully functional, fully valid. Ultimately: none of this involves inherent existence. Conventional production through empty conditions. The EMPTINESS is what makes it WORK.","commonMisconception":"V.24 is NOT nihilism. It doesn't say causation doesn't exist. It says INHERENT causation doesn't exist. CONVENTIONAL causation is AFFIRMED by the very analysis that denies inherent causation. Emptiness enables convention."},"quantumResonance":{"concept":"Conventional Production Through Empty Processes","score":62,"strength":"Medium","explanation":"Physics: production occurs through conventional processes (vacuum fluctuations, field dynamics) without inherent mechanisms. Because things are empty, they CAN arise, change, and cease. If they were inherently existent, they'd be permanent and unchanging.
